mapper.select: SELECT r.INSTITUTION_ID, r.ROUND_SEQ, r.ANCHOR_LAST_BID, i.LAST_BID AS CUR_LAST_BID, l.REV_NO, l.STATUS_CD, l.NEXT_CHECK_DATE, l.HANDLER_NAME, l.EMP_VERIFIED, l.HANDLED_AT FROM NOTICE_ROUND r JOIN NOTICE_ROUND_LOG l ON l.INSTITUTION_ID = r.INSTITUTION_ID AND l.ROUND_SEQ = r.ROUND_SEQ LEFT JOIN INSTITUTIONS i ON i.INSTITUTION_ID = r.INSTITUTION_ID WHERE r.CLOSED_AT IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM NOTICE_ROUND_LOG n WHERE n.INSTITUTION_ID = l.INSTITUTION_ID AND n.ROUND_SEQ = l.ROUND_SEQ AND n.REV_NO > l.REV_NO) ORDER BY r.INSTITUTION_ID, r.ROUND_SEQ DESC
